theme_and_archetype.description: A pristine, high-utility, whitespace-heavy design inspired by Linear, Stripe, and modern Silicon Valley SaaS. Emphasizes clean borders, subtle minimal shadows, generous padding, and a single premium cobalt accent color.

scale.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl tracking-tight leading-none font-semibold text-slate-900
scale.h2: text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl tracking-tight leading-snug font-medium text-slate-900

landing_page.header: Crystal Glass sticky header (backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/70, border-b border-gray-200/50)
landing_page.hero: Asymmetric bento layout. Large H1 left-aligned, live stats counters right/bottom.
landing_page.sections: Generous spacing (py-32). Alternating pure white and soft gray backgrounds.

dashboard.shell: Fixed left sidebar (w-64, bg-gray-50, border-r border-gray-200). Top header (h-16, bg-white, border-b border-gray-200) for breadcrumbs, search, and profile. Main content area (bg-white) with max-width optimization.

button.primary: bg-blue-600 text-white hover:bg-blue-700 shadow-sm transition-all rounded-md px-4 py-2 text-sm font-medium
button.secondary: bg-white text-slate-700 border border-gray-200 hover:bg-gray-50 hover:text-slate-900 shadow-sm rounded-md px-4 py-2 text-sm font-medium
button.ghost: bg-transparent text-slate-600 hover:bg-gray-100 hover:text-slate-900 rounded-md px-4 py-2 text-sm font-medium
button.danger: bg-red-50 text-red-600 hover:bg-red-100 rounded-md px-4 py-2 text-sm font-medium

card.base: bg-white border border-gray-200 rounded-xl shadow-sm overflow-hidden
card.internship_card: Includes company logo (w-10 h-10 rounded-md border), clear typography hierarchy (H3 for title, small text for company), flex layout for tags (Fixed/Hybrid/Unpaid).
card.stat_card: p-6. Large metric (text-3xl font-semibold), subtle icon (text-gray-400), sparkline or trend indicator (+12% text-green-600).

input.base: w-full border border-gray-300 rounded-md px-3 py-2 text-sm text-slate-900 placeholder:text-gray-400 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500/20 focus:border-blue-500 transition-colors

badge.base: inline-flex items-center px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full text-xs font-medium
badge.verified: bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-700 border border-emerald-200 with small check icon

kanban.column: w-80 flex-shrink-0 flex flex-col bg-gray-50 rounded-lg p-4
kanban.item: bg-white border border-gray-200 rounded-md p-4 shadow-sm mb-3 cursor-grab active:cursor-grabbing hover:border-blue-300 transition-colors

animations.staggered_list: Use motion.div with staggered children delays for internship feed and kanban cards.
animations.marquee: Slow, smooth drift. react-fast-marquee with grayscale logos and hover-pause.

testing.attributes: All interactive elements must include data-testid. Examples: data-testid='apply-button', data-testid='internship-card-123', data-testid='sidebar-nav-jobs'.

hero_background.description: Clean, modern laptop on wooden desk setup. Use with white/gray gradient overlay (bg-white/80) to ensure text legibility.

chennai_skyline.description: Aerial view of colorful high-rise buildings in Chennai. Use for ecosystem/domain coverage sections.

institution_building.description: Modern university building for institution placeholders.

icons.style: Stroke width 1.5px, consistent sizing (w-4 h-4 for inline, w-6 h-6 for standalone).

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure the entire app feels like a high-end enterprise SaaS product (Linear/Stripe influence). Avoid heavy shadows; prefer 1px borders and slight shadow-sm.
Do NOT use raw HTML `<select>` or `<input type='date'>`. Use Shadcn UI for forms, tabs, dialogs, and dropdowns.
Implement real-time styled dashboards with exact Kanbans for startups and smart match score badges.
Use staggered Framer Motion or Tailwind animate-in for lists and page loads.
Strictly follow the color palette: mostly white, soft gray surface backgrounds, black text, and blue-600 for primary CTA.
Do not hallucinate random image URLs; use the media provided in this JSON.
Include data-testid on all interactive elements as per the E1 testing rules.
The Hero image must be placed behind a strong white gradient overlay (e.g. bg-white/80 or bg-gradient-to-r from-white via-white/90 to-transparent) so dark text stands out perfectly.
